title: Evaluation of a sign-cube restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a set of coordinates in the length-$n$ index set, and let $f$ map sign-valued vectors of length $n$ to a type $\alpha$. For any assignment $z$ of signs on the coordinates outside $J$ and any assignment $y$ of signs on $J$, the restriction of $f$ determined by $J$ and $z$, evaluated at $y$, equals $f$ evaluated on the vector formed by combining $y$ and $z$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of length-$n$ coordinates
